confirmed_findings.claim: The fast policy hook unconditionally denies Write/Edit to acdsl/registry.local.json in gated/strict mode, while the authoritative check permits entries listed in policy.local_overrides, making the sanctioned local-override feature unusable via normal tool calls.
confirmed_findings.fix: Teach the hook to read policy.local_overrides and only deny entries not yet present there, or drop registry.local.json from the hook's frozen-surface list and let it fall through to acdsl check.

confirmed_findings.claim: The casual skill-edit lockout (DR3) is enforced only as prose instructions in the smine-apply, smine-skills, and smine-orchestrate SKILL.md files with no mechanical code-level backstop, so a single missed instruction ships a shipped-skill edit to a casual user.
confirmed_findings.fix: Add at minimum a deterministic check in the orchestrate stage (or the wrapper itself) that diffs touched skills/*/SKILL.md frontmatter against origin: user when the profile is casual, rather than relying purely on agent judgment.

confirmed_findings.claim: The bootstrap results log uses a fixed non-run-scoped path that every stage appends to with no truncation, so it grows unbounded across runs and makes the log for a given run ambiguous.
confirmed_findings.fix: Timestamp the filename, or truncate it at the top of the script.

confirmed_findings.claim: The additionalDirectories reconciliation pipeline leaves a stray .tmp file behind in ~/.claude/ when jq fails, because the redirection creates the temp file before jq's exit status is checked and the && skips the mv.

ruleDelta silently discards ParseRules errors on both the working and base sides, so an unparseable declaration file would silently under- or over-report added/removed rules, and no test exercises this path.
The Registry struct field order is not alphabetical per RULE-GOLANG-STRUCT-002; the new loadedModTime/loadedSize fields are grouped with the mutex they are guarded alongside via a comment instead.
